edges.fact: The Watermelon Basil Margarita recipe uses about 1-2 ounces (specifically 1/2 ounce in the given recipe) of watermelon puree, made from roasted watermelon for extra sweetness.
The Watermelon Basil Margarita recipe includes 1/4 ounce of basil syrup made by steeping fresh basil leaves in a sugar syrup.
